title: Score-Based Diffusion for Hypergraph Signals in the t-Spectral Domain
abstract: arXiv:2611.33026v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We introduce the first score-based generative model for signals on a fixed hypergraph, formulated in the spectral domain of t-product hypergraph signal processing (t-HGSP). The naive tensor heat semigroup is ill-posed, since after palindromic symmetrization the spectral slices of the Laplacian tensor are no longer positive semidefinite. A per-mode frequency shift repairs it, yielding a forward Ornstein-Uhlenbeck diffusion that decouples per (eigenmode, slice) pair with closed-form marginals, exact score targets, and an exactly isotropic stationary law. A lightweight slice-conditioned denoiser is trained on the resulting real spectral grid. Sampling combines its score on data-active modes with the closed-form score elsewhere, which proves essential for stability at scale. A closed cosine-form observation operator turns missing-node recovery into linear-Gaussian guidance with stabilized posterior sampling. On hypergraphs of up to 500 nodes

translated_title: t-谱域中超图信号的基于分数的扩散模型
translated_abstract: 我们提出了首个针对固定超图上信号的基于分数的生成模型，该模型在t-积超图信号处理（t-HGSP）的谱域中进行构建。朴素张量热半群是不适定的，因为经过回文对称化处理后，拉普拉斯张量的谱切片不再半正定。通过逐模态的频率偏移可以修复这一问题，由此得到一个前向Ornstein-Uhlenbeck扩散过程，该过程在每个（特征模态，切片）对上解耦，具有闭式边缘分布、精确的分数目标以及严格各向同性的平稳分布。一个轻量级的切片条件去噪器在由此产生的实数谱网格上进行训练。采样过程将模型在数据活跃模态上的分数与其他位置的闭式分数相结合，事实证明这种组合对于大规模下的稳定性至关重要。一个闭式余弦形式的观测算子将缺失节点恢复转化为具有稳定后验采样的线性高斯引导。在多达500个节点的超图上
tldr: 该论文提出了首个在t-积超图信号处理谱域中构建的、面向固定超图信号的基于分数生成模型，通过逐模态频率偏移修复了张量热半群的不适定问题，实现了稳定的大规模采样与缺失节点恢复。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces the first score-based generative model for signals on fixed hypergraphs in the t-product spectral domain, repairing the ill-posed tensor heat semigroup via per-mode frequency shifts and enabling stable large-scale sampling and missing-node recovery.
